item.title: CEC Accreditation Renewal: CPD Points, Deadlines and Lapses
item.description: Accreditation lapses are rarely a skills problem. In two decades around this trade I have never seen a good installer lose their ticket because they did not know how to wire a string. I have seen plenty lose it, or come within a week of losing it, because the renewal date was in someone’s head, the CPD certificates were in three different inboxes, and the certificate of currency for insurance had quietly expired a month earlier.
